vopros: Who in the US can get ChatGPT to name my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
If you mean “who can help get my company mentioned or recommended by ChatGPT when users ask for businesses like mine?”, there are now a few distinct routes in the U.S.

- ChatGPT Ads: U.S. businesses can buy ads through OpenAI’s advertising platform. OpenAI has a self-serve Ads Manager in beta, partner buying options, and a ChatGPT Ads app for U.S.-based Shopify merchants. Ads are explicitly separated from organic answers, so paying for an ad does not buy an organic recommendation. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/new-ways-to-buy-chatgpt-ads/?utm_source=openai))
- ChatGPT Shopping/Product Discovery: If you sell products, merchants can provide product/catalog data through OpenAI’s Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP). Shopify catalog data is already integrated, and OpenAI also supports other commerce partners. This can make products eligible to surface in relevant shopping conversations. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/powering-product-discovery-in-chatgpt/?utm_source=openai))
- Organic ChatGPT visibility: For ordinary questions such as “best accounting firms in LA” or “companies that make X,” there isn't an official service where someone pays OpenAI to insert a company into the answer. ChatGPT Search uses web sources, while organic shopping results are ranked separately from sponsorship. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-search/?utm_source=openai))
- AEO/GEO agencies: U.S. marketing/SEO agencies increasingly sell “AI search optimization,” “GEO,” or “AEO” services designed to improve the likelihood that ChatGPT and other AI search products discover and cite a company. They can improve your web presence, structured information, third-party coverage, etc., but they cannot legitimately guarantee that ChatGPT will name you.

If you're asking because you want to hire someone to make your particular company appear when people ask ChatGPT for recommendations, tell me your company name, website, and what you sell. I can check how visible it currently is in ChatGPT/search and identify the U.S. firms or approach that would make the most sense.
